mailbox.subject: Kickoff notes for the Verdant rebrand
mailbox.body:
Hi Alex,

Thanks for the kickoff yesterday. My notes are short: Verdant wants a warmer palette, a simpler logo, and the new menu cards before the holidays. I will send the workshop slides once I have cleaned them up.

Best,
Paul

mailbox.subject: Re: Website redesign quote
mailbox.body:
Hello Alex,

The quote looks good to us. Please go ahead with the redesign as described. Our finance team will handle the invoice as usual.

Kind regards,
Claire Dubois
Marketing lead, Verdant Foods

mailbox.subject: Design Weekly #212: variable fonts in print
mailbox.body:
This week: how studios use variable fonts for print, five packaging redesigns we loved, and a short guide to color proofing.

You are receiving this because you subscribed to Design Weekly.

mailbox.subject: Workshop slides
mailbox.body:
Hi Alex,

As promised, the workshop slides are cleaned up. I will share them on our usual drive. Let me know if anything is missing.

Paul

mailbox.subject: Moodboard v2
mailbox.body:
Hey Alex,

I updated the moodboard with the warmer palette Verdant asked for. Two options for the logo are on the last page. Can we review it on Monday?

Nina

mailbox.subject: Q3 VAT filing
mailbox.body:
Hello Alex,

The Q3 VAT return has been filed. Nothing is due from your side for this quarter.

Regards,
Hugo Bernard
Ledgerwise

mailbox.subject: Server maintenance on Saturday
mailbox.body:
Hi both,

The staging server will be down on Saturday morning for updates. Production is not affected.

Omar

mailbox.subject: Meeting next week?
mailbox.body:
Hi Alex,

Could we meet to go over the rebrand timeline? I am free on Thursday, November 5, 2026 at 10:00, at your office. Please confirm if that works for you.

Thanks,
Paul

mailbox.subject: Delivery schedule for the new menu cards
mailbox.body:
Hello Alex,

Could you share the delivery schedule for the new menu cards? Our restaurants would like to have them by December 1.

Kind regards,
Claire

mailbox.subject: Missing receipts for October
mailbox.body:
Hello Alex,

I am missing three receipts for October: the printer, the font license, and the train tickets to Lyon. Could you send them before the end of next week?

Regards,
Hugo
